scope: Final gpt-6-astra guardian-only run: all 32 latest-stage images, eight complete input windows, and recorded additional historical images. All 286 stage input file hashes verified. Text/criteria inspected for all 32 responses. This is an evidence audit, not a new clinical or industrial qualification and not an assertion that every temporal relation was independently viewed.
method: Inspect the actual frozen JPEG inputs at their native source resolution; distinguish visible phase cues, historical episode compatibility and complete temporal criteria. Do not infer unseen future frames, independent evidence from repeated held images, repetition counts or clinical/industrial suitability. Preserve banks and scores.
hash_scheme: File SHA256 uses exact bytes. source_row_sha256 uses parsed row JSON sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, encoded UTF-8.

priority_findings.finding: Final raw S4C1/S4C2 are unknown, correctly preserving missing future-scene evidence. Raw phase identity can be compatible with the current monochrome view while completion stays unknown; the displayed stage is withheld.

Historical frame 2 does not independently resolve whole-shoe floor clearance at native 428×240. Raw S7C1/S7C2 met should be treated as limited/ambiguous. Both remain unknown in admitted workflow progress; no completed step is reported.
Sport S2/S3 raised→low is not a full low→raise→low repetition. Dance S8 separation precedes the newest cross. Absent future transitions and obscured floor contacts remain unknown/partial.
